race.description: Boxing Day Races At The Arc Mdn
race.comment: ZALI'S GIFT (8) earns top billing after a much better second at Bunbury, where she came from back in the field and was beaten just under two lengths. The Northam failure prior was too bad to be her true level. Just has to repeat her latest effort to be winning this. TASMAN JEWEL (9) is the obvious danger after a head defeat as favourite at this track. She continues to knock on the door of a maiden win and she maps to get every chance out in distance today. Can make her presence felt again third-up. SEA OF GALILEE (1) comes back from a five-week break after an eighth in mid-week company at Belmont Park, but his narrow Kalgoorlie fourth two back keeps him in the mix. TWILIGHT GOD (3) has to rebound from a plain first-up run here, yet his lone placing at the distance gives him enough grounding to press for a minor upset if he improves second-up. THROUGH THE NEVER (7) closed nicely on debut and the rise in trip looks to suit.
